title: PES v6 keeps a trim between same-colour parts through a PE-DESIGN re-save
description: Two Red running lines 40 mm apart sew as one colour with a trim between them. In the PES 6 file the PEC section flags the move as a trim and the CEmbOne/CSewSeg stitch group stores it as a jump segment, which is also how PE-DESIGN 11's own Ver.6.0 re-save stores it (CSewSeg has no trim type). PE-DESIGN reopens a.pes and re-saves it with the trim.

evidence.note: docs/COMPATIBILITY_AUDIT.md: CSewSeg drops trims; PEC keeps them
CSewSeg stitch type 0 = normal, 1 = jump; trims not described

PE-DESIGN 11.50 re-saves of a.pes (MANIFEST pes-csewseg-trims; the Ver.6.0 copy is crates/openstitch-formats/tests/fixtures/pe_design_v6_trims.pes): CSewSeg runs stitch, jump (flag 1), stitch; PEC keeps the 0x20 trim flag

pageMode custom (#1013): the reference is PE-DESIGN's re-save of a.pes as OpenStitch wrote it, and PE-DESIGN drops a zero-length stitch when it opens a stitch file. Round 12 (2026-11-13) re-saved today's Hoop Size export, which starts with the stitch in place, and the re-save starts on the landing without it (D:/_sandboxes/PE-reference-notes/round12/pes-csewseg-trims.pes; the spec's reference is unchanged, as its stitches are the same). So the spec's design stays on a Custom Size page, whose stream PE-DESIGN keeps as written.

references.make: Run `stitchtool compat --only pes-csewseg-trims` and open target/compat/work/pes-csewseg-trims/a.pes in PE-DESIGN 11 (two Red running lines (20,20)-(60,20) and (20,60)-(60,60) mm, run pitch 2.5 mm, run times 1, one colour, a trim between them). Note whether PE shows the move between the lines and the Jump Stitch Trimming option; change nothing. Save As PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

measurements.evidence: 40 mm travel inside one colour is over the 3 mm trim distance
the PEC section flags the jump as a trim
PE-DESIGN's re-save keeps the trim (PEC 0x20 flag)
PE-DESIGN 11 reopens a.pes with the same stitches, jumps and trims
